versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Liquor License & Alcohol Compliance Agent.
- Provides tailored regulatory compliance guidance for bars, restaurants, breweries, distilleries, and retailers across all 50 US states.
- Features license type assessment, state regulatory mapping, compliance checklists, violation risk scoring, staff training mandates, special event permitting, and label/advertising compliance.
- Includes sample usage instructions, detailed reference tables for licenses and regulations by state, and a customizable pre-inspection checklist.
- Covers key violation categories, penalties, and scenarios requiring escalation to a liquor attorney.
